material.text: opencode-tailscale: Tailscale settings and mobile pairing for OpenCode Desktop.

type=plugin source=npm:opencode-tailscale created=2026-11-12T15:43:09.480Z firstSeen=2026-11-15T14:40:44.098Z published=2026-11-13T10:15:34.609Z maintainers=mattrobrob repoId=1455498720 stars=0 npm30d=?

# opencode-tailscale Connect to OpenCode through Tailscale from OpenCode Desktop. - View your Tailscale connection status and device details. - View and create private Tailscale Serve proxies to your OpenCode server. - Pair the OpenCode mobile app using a QR code or pairing link.
